notablePrerequisites:
One of Trade Caravan or Mirrormade has a currency counter on it.
You control a basic Island.
description:
During your upkeep, Stasis, Trade Caravan and Mirrormade trigger.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Resolve the Trade Caravan and Mirrormade triggers, putting a currency counter on each of them.
During an opponent's upkeep, activate either Trade Caravan or Mirrormade by removing two currency counters from it, untapping a basic Island.
Repeat.

uses.name: Mirrormade
uses.cardState: as a copy of Trade Caravan
